summary: Iter 227 cookie-session migration validated end-to-end. Backend pytest (12/12 passing). Frontend critical flows verified: main login lands on dashboard (no 'Loading...' splash, no /login bounce); localStorage.token === 'cookie' sentinel (NOT a JWT); document.cookie does NOT expose ga_session (HttpOnly); session persists through full page reload of /master-admin; navigation to /service-desk and back keeps session; logout (POST /api/auth/logout + localStorage clear) redirects subsequent /master-admin visit to /login; owner@apexfitness.group regression login renders dashboard with widgets populated (proves ~300 'Bearer cookie'/'Bearer null' call-sites authenticate via cookie); Pulse Admin sidebar shows 'Engineer App' button which opens view-as picker modal listing engineers; Engineer role option present in account-team-invite-role select (verified at source: team.js L215, L352 gated on isOwner).

issues: Email field uses input[type=text] with placeholder 'you@gym.com' instead of input[type=email] — review_request mentions 'wait for input[type=email]', but the field is actually type=text. Minor a11y/autofill concern only; not blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Add type=email to login email input to match testing contract and improve mobile keyboard/UX.

(Optional, future) Consider also clearing localStorage 'token' sentinel automatically in App.js logout() so a stale 'cookie' value never lingers if server-side cookie clear succeeds but client redirect is interrupted.
critical_code_review_comments: Cookie-only session design is correctly implemented: backend _extract_token ignores 'cookie'/'null'/'undefined' Bearer sentinels and falls through to HttpOnly ga_session; /auth/refresh rotates cookie ONLY for cookie/sentinel sessions, preserving impersonation header tokens.
Engineer role auto-provisioning wired in account.py _sync_engineer_provisioning works (covered by pytest test_engineer_role_autoprovisions_and_deactivates).
Pulse-scoped /master-admin/engineers list correctly filters by Pulse org (test_pulse_admin_scope_only_pulse_visible).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 5 session-critical scenarios + Pulse engineer-app picker + verified Engineer role option in team.js source
